title: Tomato Curry
instructions: Fry onions and fresh ginger until translucent, add garlic and fry for 30s.
Add aromatic spices and toast a bit.
Add chopped up tomatoes and cook for a few minutes.
Mix some flour with water and add it in, stir until thickened.
Serve with bread and spring onion.
notes: If you do not add flour, it can basically be a soup.
